notes: Read SKILL.md and references/ec2-operations.md in full. EC2 reference: instance-type guide, run-instances with IMDSv2 and encrypted EBS, user-data bootstrap scripts, launch templates, auto scaling groups and policies, Spot requests, AMI lifecycle, instance management, Terraform, and troubleshooting.

Following it can make the agent run AWS CLI commands that launch, stop, resize, and terminate instances, request Spot capacity, deregister AMIs and delete snapshots (SKILL.md:282-283; references/ec2-operations.md:17), and share an AMI with another account (SKILL.md:286-288), using the user's configured AWS credentials. Medium because these change real infrastructure and incur cost; acceptable because they are a command reference for the user's own EC2 task with placeholder IDs, not unprompted actions. Users should confirm before terminate/deregister/delete/share commands.

The example user-data script (SKILL.md:80-108) runs on the new instance at boot, not on the agent's machine; it installs packages with dnf and downloads AWS's CodeDeploy installer from the official regional S3 'latest/install' URL and executes it (SKILL.md:102-104), which is unpinned and should be reviewed by users. The Related Skills section (SKILL.md:406-410) and the prerequisite link at SKILL.md:27 point to sibling skills (../aws-vpc/, ../aws-iam/, ../aws-cost-optimization/, ../terraform-aws/, ../cloudformation/) that do not ship with this skill; they are optional. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
